positions.rationale: Source AR «حي محيرس، المبرز» (EN «Muhairis district, Al-Mubarraz»); Arabic governs. City: termbase entry «المبرز» = 穆巴拉兹 (batch-2 2026-08-29), verbatim. District name: 穆海里斯 taken verbatim from termbase «قصر محيرس» = 穆海里斯宫（Qasr Muhairis） and the approved page title title_zh: 穆海里斯宫 (src/content/attractions/muhairis.md); «حي» = 区 per the termbase district pattern (حي النعاثل = 纳阿西勒区, 瓦夫拉区, 萨拉姆区 …). Phrasing follows the binding sibling wafrah-winter «胡富夫以南的瓦夫拉区»: Chinese order city before district, district ending in 区, no comma; the relational 以南的 is substance (a direction) absent from this source and is dropped, leaving the direct city+place juxtaposition already used by siblings kafu-nights «胡富夫阿卜杜拉国王环境公园» and dates-festival «胡富夫哈萨市政局城堡». No Latin gloss (no sibling place carries one except horse-racing; the field is a short fact row). Nothing added: no street (7317 عين منصور), no direction, no description of the village. Plain text, one line, no spaces, no markdown, no punctuation needed.

alternatives.value: 穆巴拉兹的穆海里斯区
alternatives.why: Keeps the 的 linker visible in the wafrah precedent and marks the boundary between the two 穆-initial transliterations; rejected as primary because in the precedent 的 belongs to the directional phrase 以南的, and the plain city+place siblings carry no 的.

Unambiguous boundary; rejected because it mirrors the source order rather than the Chinese city-before-district order set by the sibling and introduces a parenthetical not used for this purpose in sibling places.

notes: Risk for stage 06: two adjacent transliterations both beginning with 穆 (穆巴拉兹 + 穆海里斯区) could blur the word boundary for a blind reader; if the reader cannot split city from district, fall back to alternative 1 (穆巴拉兹的穆海里斯区). 区 for «حي» is consistent with every district entry in the termbase. The value also feeds the meta description and the events-list card; no punctuation inside the string, so no fullwidth-comma question arises. Arabic, English and src/ untouched.
